description: Application for non-material amendment of planning permission ref: PA/23/00726, dated 17/10/2024.Non Material Amendment(S) Sought:This application seeks to amend the description of development attached to planning permission ref. PA/23/00726/S as follows: Description of development (Current): 'Retention, refurbishment, rear extension and change of use of the existing three-storey warehouse building (Use Class B8) and the erection of a three storey extension to accommodate retail floorspace at ground floor level (Use Class E) and office floorspace on the upper levels (Use Class E), together with ancillary servicing and cycle parking.' To be amended to: 'Retention, refurbishment, rear extension and change of use of the existing three-storey warehouse building (Use Class B8) and the erection of a three-storey extension to accommodate retail floorspace at ground floor level (Use Class E) and commercial floorspace on the upper levels (Use Class E), together with ancillary servicing and cycle parking.
